title: BYOK AI in LiveAgent: Use Your Own AI Provider
snippet:
BYOK AI (bring your own key) means you connect your own AI provider account to a software product with an API key, and the provider bills you for what you use. In LiveAgent you can connect OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini or FlowHunt. LiveAgent adds no AI fees, no token markup and no per-resolution fees.

You pay two parties for two different things: LiveAgent for your plan, and your AI provider for the AI usage on your account, at its own prices.
| Who you pay | What for | What LiveAgent adds |
|---|---|---|
| LiveAgent | Your plan | No AI fees, no token markup, no per-resolution fees |
| Your AI provider | The AI usage on your own account, at the provider’s prices | Nothing |
Plans differ in how many AI agents you can create: 1 on Starter, 5 on Team, 50 on Business and unlimited on Enterprise. Check the [AI billing on the pricing page](https://liveagent.com/pricing/) for the current plans. LiveAgent does not publish your provider’s prices, so look up the current rates with your provider before you decide.

Start a free [30-day trial](https://liveagent.com/trial/), no credit card needed, and connect your AI provider.

title: What are the benefits of the Enterprise plan?
snippet:
The Enterprise plan is a flat fee ($3,999 per month billed monthly, or $3,199 per month billed annually) that includes 80 agents. You can add more agents above the 80 included for $49 per month each ($39 per month on annual billing).
## No plan limits
The Enterprise plan has no plan limits on:
- departments
- email accounts
- chat buttons
- contact forms
- canned messages and predefined answers
- event rules, time rules and SLA rules
- custom roles
- API keys
- custom ticket filters
- WhatsApp numbers and Telegram bots
- AI agents
## Also included
- 10 knowledge bases.
- All features, including the call center, reporting, SSO, audit log, department roles and branding removal.
- The MCP server, so you can connect LiveAgent to external AI tools such as Claude.
- A dedicated account manager, priority support, service review calls and reports, custom billing setup and scheduled release management.
## AI features
AI features run on your own AI provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini or FlowHunt), and LiveAgent doesn't charge for AI. "Unlimited" means no plan limit. To keep LiveAgent fast and reliable for everyone, technical and rate limits still apply to AI agents, the API and the MCP server to prevent misuse.

title: Documentation
snippet:
1. Consider registering a new [free Trial account](https://www.liveagent.com/trial/) for testing purposes, before using API with your live account.
2. Generate API key for APIv3: [https://support.liveagent.com/741982-API-key](https://support.liveagent.com/741982-API-key)
3. Authorize the LiveAgent API on https://**YOURDOMAIN.**ladesk.com/docs/api/v3/#/ and add scopes you need for the API to work:
![](https://support.liveagent.com/public/article/12773/attachment/k912nbjf1k8z7ejg7nho8pa3m9dpbeen/view)
4. Choose the object (agents, tickets, .) & method (get, post, delete) and press the "Try it out" button
![](https://support.liveagent.com/public/article/12773/attachment/3hl5gjt6bzz426xqg7jh9lucmu9nkdao/view)
5. Fill the required parameters, press the "execute" button & see the results
![](https://support.liveagent.com/public/article/12773/attachment/isxt5mu5b6wua24d2kl0si6br404bp90/view)
There are limits related to API and API keys. [Here](https://support.liveagent.com/931802-API-rate-limit-API-requests-limit) you can find more info.
